column1: # GENERATED by ./gradlew generateBedrockConstants. Do not edit.
# Bedrock's internal short name for a vanilla item, and Java's translation key for it.
# The whole key, because a block's item form is `block.minecraft.` in Java and
# everything else `item.minecraft.`, and that is not derivable from the path.
# Joined on the English display name and kept only where that name is unique in BOTH
# games; a hand-written answer in spec/upstream/vanilla-names.manual.yaml overrides.
# No upstream content is reproduced here - an id beside an id is a fact about two
# games, not Mojang's data. Constitution rule 10, spec/upstream/fetch.md.
